question: How can one reality be both one and many as the nature of time and timeless divisions?
premises: There are divisions beyond ordinary time.
The addressed reality is both one and many.
inference: The supreme nature underlies and unifies all temporal and atemporal divisions as both singular and manifold.
uncertainties: The internal parsing of the long compound allows multiple technical readings.
plain_english: O you who are the one and many nature of the divisions of time-units, fashioned by time beyond time.
